title: MCMyWay - Main
description: A full overhaul of the UI that screams my name.
body:
This is a personalized pack that replaces the grand majority of Minecraft's non-diegetic textures with those that fit the theme of EnergetiCraft. Certain details change depending on what Minecraft version a given pack version is for.

<details>
<summary>Integrations</summary>

This pack supports the following mods:
- [Music Player](https://modrinth.com/mod/music-player) by [HyCraftHD](https://modrinth.com/user/HyCraftHD)

More integrations may be added over time.

</details>
